data LocalLifecycleAuthorityError
  = LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed !OperationSubprocessError
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityKubeconfigFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityProcessStartFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid !ControlPlaneClientError
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityChannelClosed
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityRequestRefused !ControlPlaneClientError
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityHintRefused !RpcOwnBindingHintError
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityHintHttpStatus !Int
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError :: LocalLifecycleAuthorityError -> String
renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError err = case err of
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause -> "owned Lifecycle Authority transport: " ++ show cause
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline -> "owned Lifecycle Authority transport reached its original work deadline"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed -> "prepare owned Lifecycle Authority kubeconfig workspace"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityKubeconfigFailed detail ->
    "resolve home Lifecycle Authority kubeconfig: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail ->
    "reserve Lifecycle Authority loopback port: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityProcessStartFailed detail ->
    "start Lifecycle Authority Service port-forward: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed detail ->
    "Lifecycle Authority Service is not ready: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid detail ->
    "construct Lifecycle Authority client: " ++ show detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityChannelClosed -> "owned Lifecycle Authority channel is closed"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityRequestRefused cause -> "owned Lifecycle Authority request: " ++ show cause
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityHintRefused cause -> "owned Lifecycle Authority hint: " ++ show cause
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityHintHttpStatus status -> "owned Lifecycle Authority hint HTTP status: " ++ show status

withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClient
  :: (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClient =
  withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClientUsing lifecycleAuthorityClient

withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClientUsing
  :: ( Int
       -> Either
            ControlPlaneClientError
            (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)
     )
  -> (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClientUsing buildClient action = do
  kubeconfigResult <- resolveLocalKubeconfig
  case kubeconfigResult of
    Left detail -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityKubeconfigFailed detail))
    Right kubeconfig -> do
      portResult <- reserveLoopbackPort
      case portResult of
        Left detail ->
          pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail))
        Right localPort -> do
          environment <- homeKubectlEnvironment kubeconfig
          bracket
            (startForward environment localPort)
            cleanupForward
            (runWithForward localPort)
 where
  runWithForward _ (Left err) = pure (Left err)
  runWithForward localPort (Right _) = do
    ready <- waitUntilStartupProbe LifecycleAuthorityRuntime localPort readinessAttempts
    case ready of
      Left detail ->
        pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed detail))
      Right () ->
        case buildClient localPort of
          Left err -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid err))
          Right client -> Right <$> action client

-- | Open the same loopback-only connection but expose only the complete
-- authenticated transport.  Signer, scope, epoch, deadline, and durable nonce
-- ownership are explicit caller inputs; this boundary never invents them from
-- host state.
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport
  :: AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers action =
  withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClient
    (action . mkAuthenticatedClientTransport bounds providers)

-- The operation owns both this persistent child and all concurrent command work.
-- Only the canonical retained-home Authority mapping is representable here.
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport
  :: OperationSubprocesses
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport processes config environment bounds providers action =
  withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum
    ReplayBudget.authorityMetadataResponseMaximumBytes
    processes
    config
    environment
    (action . operationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers)

-- The client cannot be selected or extracted by callers. Release joins every
-- bounded use before closing the lease; escaped uses subsequently refuse.
-- Neither a channel nor its local lifetime grants Authority admission.
data OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  = OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
      !OperationAuthorityChannelScope
      !(ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)

data OperationAuthorityChannelUse
  = ChannelScopeOpen !Natural
  | ChannelScopeClosing !Natural

data OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  = OperationAuthorityChannelScope !OperationTransport !(TVar OperationAuthorityChannelUse)

withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  :: OperationSubprocesses
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel =
  withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum rpcBirthRegistryResponseMaximumBytes

operationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport
  :: AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  -> AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime
operationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope client) =
  mkAuthenticatedClientTransport bounds guarded client
 where
  guarded =
    AuthenticatedClientProviders
      { provideAuthenticatedClientSigner = do
          provided <- guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientSigner providers)
          pure $ do
            signer <- provided
            first (const "owned Authority channel signer invalid") $
              mkRequestSigningCapability
                (requestSigningCapabilityPrincipal signer)
                (requestSigningCapabilityGeneration signer)
                (requestSigningCapabilityPublicKeyBytes signer)
                ( \bytes ->
                    guardChannelProvider
                      scope
                      (first (Text.pack . show) <$> signCanonicalBytesWithRequestCapability signer bytes)
                )
      , provideAuthenticatedClientScope =
          guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientScope providers)
      , provideAuthenticatedClientEpoch =
          guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientEpoch providers)
      , provideAuthenticatedClientDeadline =
          guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientDeadline providers)
      , provideAuthenticatedClientNonce =
          guardChannelProvider scope (provideAuthenticatedClientNonce providers)
      }

guardChannelProvider
  :: OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  -> IO (Either Text.Text value)
  -> IO (Either Text.Text value)
guardChannelProvider scope action =
  either (Left . Text.pack . renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError) id
    <$> withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope action

verifyOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelBeforeEffect
  :: OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError ())
verifyOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelBeforeEffect (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope _) =
  withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope (pure ())

requestOperationLifecycleAuthorityOwnBindingHint
  :: OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel
  -> RpcOwnBindingQuery
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError RpcOwnBindingHint)
requestOperationLifecycleAuthorityOwnBindingHint (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope client) query =
  fmap join $ withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope $ do
    response <- callControlPlane client LifecycleMigrationApplyRoute (encodeRpcOwnBindingQuery query)
    decoded <- evaluate $ case response of
      Left cause -> Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityRequestRefused cause)
      Right (ControlPlaneResponse status body)
        | status /= 200 -> Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityHintHttpStatus status)
        | otherwise ->
            either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityHintRefused) Right (decodeRpcOwnBindingHint query body)
    case decoded of
      Left cause -> cause `seq` pure (Left cause)
      Right hint -> hint `seq` pure (Right hint)

-- Nested signing validation can itself read the registry. Counted borrows
-- allow that nesting without holding a mutex across its effects. Closing
-- refuses new borrows and joins every original-bound provider/signature/HTTP use.
withOperationAuthorityChannelUse
  :: OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  -> IO value
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationAuthorityChannelUse (OperationAuthorityChannelScope lease uses) action = mask $ \restore -> do
  admitted <- atomically $ do
    state <- readTVar uses
    case state of
      ChannelScopeOpen count -> writeTVar uses (ChannelScopeOpen (count + 1)) >> pure True
      ChannelScopeClosing _ -> pure False
  if not admitted
    then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityChannelClosed)
    else restore run `finally` atomically (modifyTVar' uses release)
 where
  ending = operationTransportWorkEnd lease
  run = do
    now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
    if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
      then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
      else do
        let micros = fromInteger (min (toInteger (maxBound :: Int)) (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
        attempted <- timeout micros $ do
          before <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
          case before of
            Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
            Right () -> do
              value <- action >>= evaluate
              closing <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
              pure (value <$ first LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed closing)
        after <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        pure $
          if after >= ending
            then Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline
            else maybe (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline) id attempted
  release state = case state of
    ChannelScopeOpen count -> ChannelScopeOpen (count - 1)
    ChannelScopeClosing count -> ChannelScopeClosing (count - 1)

closeOperationAuthorityChannel :: OperationAuthorityChannelScope -> IO ()
closeOperationAuthorityChannel (OperationAuthorityChannelScope _ uses) = uninterruptibleMask_ $ do
  atomically (modifyTVar' uses beginClosing)
  atomically $ do
    state <- readTVar uses
    check $ case state of
      ChannelScopeOpen _ -> False
      ChannelScopeClosing count -> count == 0
 where
  beginClosing state = case state of
    ChannelScopeOpen count -> ChannelScopeClosing count
    ChannelScopeClosing count -> ChannelScopeClosing count

withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum
  :: Int
  -> OperationSubprocesses
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityChannelUsingMaximum maximumBytes processes config environment action = do
  admitted <- verifyOperationSubprocessesBeforeEffect processes
  case admitted of
    Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
    Right () -> do
      attempted <- tryOperationClientWorkspace $ do
        directory <-
          createTempDirectory (operationSubprocessRuntimeDirectory processes) "authority-forward-"
        use directory
      pure (either (const (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed)) id attempted)
 where
  use directory = do
    written <- writeEmbeddedHomeKubeconfig directory config
    case written of
      Left _ -> pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed)
      Right kubeconfig -> do
        port <- reserveLoopbackPort
        case port of
          Left detail -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail))
          Right localPort -> do
            let childEnvironment =
                  [ ("HOME", directory)
                  , ("XDG_CACHE_HOME", directory </> "cache")
                  , ("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", directory </> "config")
                  , ("XDG_DATA_HOME", directory </> "data")
                  ]
                    ++ filter (not . privateEnvironmentKey . fst) environment
                spec =
                  Subprocess
                    { subprocessPath = "kubectl"
                    , subprocessArguments =
                        [ "--kubeconfig"
                        , kubeconfig
                        , "--cache-dir"
                        , directory </> "cache"
                        , "--namespace"
                        , lifecycleAuthorityNamespace
                        , "port-forward"
                        , lifecycleAuthorityForwardTarget
                        , show localPort ++ ":" ++ show lifecycleAuthorityRemotePort
                        , "--address"
                        , "127.0.0.1"
                        ]
                    , subprocessEnvironment = Just childEnvironment
                    , subprocessWorkingDirectory = Just directory
                    }
            forwarded <- withOperationTransport processes spec $ \lease -> do
              ready <- waitOperationAuthorityReady lease localPort
              case ready of
                Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
                Right () -> do
                  uses <- newTVarIO (ChannelScopeOpen 0)
                  httpGate <- newMVar ()
                  let scope = OperationAuthorityChannelScope lease uses
                  case operationAuthorityChannelClient maximumBytes scope httpGate localPort of
                    Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid cause))
                    Right client ->
                      (Right <$> action (OperationLifecycleAuthorityChannel scope client))
                        `finally` closeOperationAuthorityChannel scope
            pure (either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed) id forwarded)
  privateEnvironmentKey key =
    forbiddenKubectlEnvironmentKey key
      || key `elem` ["HOME", "XDG_CACHE_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "XDG_DATA_HOME"]

operationAuthorityChannelClient
  :: Int
  -> OperationAuthorityChannelScope
  -> MVar ()
  -> Int
  -> Either ControlPlaneClientError (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)
operationAuthorityChannelClient maximumBytes scope@(OperationAuthorityChannelScope lease _) httpGate localPort = do
  endpoint <- mkLifecycleAuthorityEndpoint (Text.pack (loopbackEndpoint localPort))
  controlPlaneClientWithTransport maximumBytes endpoint $ \method headers url body ->
    fmap (either (const refused) id) $
      withOperationAuthorityChannelUse scope $
        withMVar httpGate $ \() -> do
          now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
          let ending = operationTransportWorkEnd lease
          if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
            then pure expired
            else do
              let micros = fromInteger (min (toInteger (maxBound :: Int)) (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
                  config = HttpConfig (min micros (httpRequestTimeoutMicros lifecycleAuthorityHttpConfig))
              httpRequestRawBounded config maximumBytes method headers url (Just (Lazy.fromStrict body))
 where
  refused = Left (HttpBoundedTransport (HttpConnectionFailure "owned Authority channel refused"))
  expired = Left (HttpBoundedTransport (HttpTimeout "owned Authority channel original work deadline"))

tryOperationClientWorkspace :: IO value -> IO (Either IOException value)
tryOperationClientWorkspace = try

waitOperationAuthorityReady
  :: OperationTransport -> Int -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError ())
waitOperationAuthorityReady lease localPort = loop
 where
  ending = operationTransportWorkEnd lease
  endpoint = loopbackEndpoint localPort ++ localClientStartupProbePath LifecycleAuthorityRuntime
  loop = do
    observed <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
    case observed of
      Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
      Right () -> do
        now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
          then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
          else do
            let allowance = fromInteger (min 1000000 (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
            response <-
              timeout allowance $
                httpRequestRawBounded (HttpConfig allowance) 4096 "GET" [] endpoint Nothing
            after <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
            if after >= ending
              then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
              else case response of
                Just (Right (status, _)) | status >= 200 && status < 300 -> do
                  closing <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
                  pure (either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed) (const (Right ())) closing)
                Just (Left (HttpBoundedResponseTooLarge _ _)) ->
                  pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed "startup response exceeds its 4096-byte bound"))
                _ -> do
                  threadDelay (fromInteger (min 250000 ((toInteger ending - toInteger after) `div` 1000)))
                  loop

-- | Open the same exact Authority endpoint with only the response budget of
-- the Provider execution route widened to contain its admitted child schedule.
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityProviderAuthenticatedTransport
  :: AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityProviderAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers action =
  withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClientUsing
    lifecycleAuthorityProviderClient
    (action . mkAuthenticatedClientTransport bounds providers)

-- | Open the same exact Authority endpoint with only the response budget of
-- the retained-delivery route widened to contain its persisted operation.
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityRetainedDeliveryAuthenticatedTransport
  :: AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)

    lifecycleAuthorityRetainedDeliveryClient

-- | Open the same exact Authority endpoint with only the response budget of
-- the closed TLS retention workflow widened to contain its longest program.
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityTlsWorkflowAuthenticatedTransport
  :: AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityTlsWorkflowAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers action =

-- | Retry the complete disposable Authority Backup port-forward lifecycle.
-- Only listener liveness is pending: setup/client failures are terminal, and
-- the user action is inside a successful attempt so its result is never
-- repeated. 'bracket' retires the current child before the inter-attempt delay.
retryAuthorityBackupForwardWith
  :: Int
  -> IO ()
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError process)
  -> (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError process -> IO ())
  -> (process -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError value))
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError value)
retryAuthorityBackupForwardWith attemptBudget delay acquire release use =
  go (max 1 attemptBudget)
 where
  go remaining = do
    result <-
      bracket acquire release runStarted
    case result of
      Left err@(LocalAuthorityBackupLivenessFailed _)
        | remaining > 1 -> delay >> go (remaining - 1)
        | otherwise -> pure (Left err)
      _ -> pure result
  runStarted started = case started of
    Left err -> pure (Left err)
    Right process -> use process

waitForAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
  :: Int
  -> BackgroundProcess
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError ())
waitForAuthorityBackupForwardStartup localPort process =
  case backgroundStdoutHandle process of
    Nothing ->
      pure
        ( classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
            localPort
            AuthorityBackupForwardStartupReadFailed
        )
    Just stdoutHandle -> do
      observed <-
        timeout
          authorityBackupForwardStartupTimeoutMicros
          (try (hGetLine stdoutHandle) :: IO (Either IOException String))
      pure
        ( classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
            localPort
            ( case observed of
                Nothing -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupTimedOut
                Just (Left _) -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupReadFailed
                Just (Right line) -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupLine line
            )
        )

classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
  :: Int
  -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupObservation
  -> Either LocalAuthorityBackupError ()
classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup localPort observation =
  case observation of
    AuthorityBackupForwardStartupTimedOut -> refused "startup acknowledgement timed out"
    AuthorityBackupForwardStartupReadFailed -> refused "startup acknowledgement unavailable"
    AuthorityBackupForwardStartupLine line
      | line `elem` expectedLines -> Right ()
      | otherwise -> refused "startup acknowledgement did not match the compiled loopback mapping"
 where
  refused = Left . LocalAuthorityBackupLivenessFailed
  expectedLines =
    [ "Forwarding from 127.0.0.1:" ++ show localPort ++ mappingSuffix
    , "Forwarding from [::1]:" ++ show localPort ++ mappingSuffix
    ]
  mappingSuffix = " -> " ++ show authorityBackupRemotePort

waitUntilStartupProbe :: RuntimeRole -> Int -> Int -> IO (Either String ())
waitUntilStartupProbe role localPort remaining = do
  result <-
    httpRequestNoBody
      readinessHttpConfig
      "GET"
      []
      (loopbackEndpoint localPort ++ localClientStartupProbePath role)
  case result of
    Right () -> pure (Right ())
    Left err
      | remaining <= 1 -> pure (Left (renderHttpError err))
      | otherwise -> do
          threadDelay 250000
          waitUntilStartupProbe role localPort (remaining - 1)

reserveLoopbackPort :: IO (Either String Int)
reserveLoopbackPort = do
  attempted <-
    try
      ( withSocketsDo $
          bracket
            (socket AF_INET Stream defaultProtocol)
            close
            ( \reserved -> do
                setSocketOption reserved ReuseAddr 1
                bind reserved (SockAddrInet 0 (tupleToHostAddress (127, 0, 0, 1)))
                address <- getSocketName reserved
                case address of
                  SockAddrInet port _ -> pure (fromIntegral port)
                  _ -> ioError (userError "reserved socket was not IPv4")
            )
      )
      :: IO (Either IOException Int)
  pure (either (Left . displayException) Right attempted)

-- | Errors that surface from an HTTP request through this module.
data HttpError
  = HttpConnectionFailure String
  | HttpTimeout String
  | HttpStatus Int String
  | HttpDecode String
  deriving (Eq, Show)

instance Exception HttpError

-- | Error from a response whose body is consumed under an allocation bound.
-- Transport failures retain the shared 'HttpError' taxonomy; crossing the
-- bound is distinct and reports the first observed size beyond the ceiling.
data HttpBoundedError
  = HttpBoundedTransport !HttpError
  | HttpBoundedResponseTooLarge !Int !Int
  deriving (Eq, Show)

-- | Per-call configuration. 'httpRequestTimeoutMicros' is enforced via
-- 'responseTimeout' on the 'Request' before sending.
data HttpConfig = HttpConfig
  { httpRequestTimeoutMicros :: Int
  }
  deriving (Eq, Show)

-- | Default: 10 second timeout, mirroring the legacy @curl --max-time 10@
-- pattern used by the pre-Sprint-2.17 fetch-public-ip call sites.
defaultHttpConfig :: HttpConfig
defaultHttpConfig =
  HttpConfig {httpRequestTimeoutMicros = 10 * 1000 * 1000}

-- | Render an 'HttpError' as the single-line operator-facing string used by
-- the legacy curl call sites.
renderHttpError :: HttpError -> String
renderHttpError httpErr = case httpErr of
  HttpConnectionFailure msg -> "HTTP connection failure: " ++ msg
  HttpTimeout msg -> "HTTP timeout: " ++ msg
  HttpStatus code body ->
    "HTTP " ++ show code ++ " response: " ++ truncateBody body
  HttpDecode msg -> "HTTP response decode error: " ++ msg
 where
  truncateBody body
    | length body > 200 = take 200 body ++ "…"
    | otherwise = body

-- | The one process-wide TLS 'Manager', constructed exactly once (Sprint
-- 1.64). @http-client@ 'Manager's are designed for concurrent reuse and pool
-- connections per host, so a single shared manager is both correct and the
-- point of this singleton: counterexample @LCPC-2026-07-11@ traced a gateway
-- hot-path CPU driver to the per-call @newManager@ construction (a fresh TLS
-- context and connection pool on every request). The @unsafePerformIO@ +
-- @NOINLINE@ idiom is the standard way to create such a value once; it lives
-- only here, outside every daemon-runtime module, and the shared @Manager@ is
-- immutable after construction.
{-# NOINLINE sharedTlsManager #-}
sharedTlsManager :: Manager
sharedTlsManager = unsafePerformIO (newManager tlsManagerSettings)

-- | Run an action against the shared TLS 'Manager'. The TLS manager handles
-- both @http://@ and @https://@ URLs and reuses connections per host.
withManager :: (Manager -> IO a) -> IO a
withManager action = action sharedTlsManager

-- | Execute an HTTP request and return the parsed 'Response', translating
-- exceptions into 'HttpError'.
runRequest :: HttpConfig -> Request -> IO (Either HttpError (Response BL.ByteString))
runRequest config requestWithoutTimeout = do
  let request =
        requestWithoutTimeout
          { responseTimeout = responseTimeoutMicro (httpRequestTimeoutMicros config)
          }
  result <- try (withManager (\mgr -> httpLbs request mgr))
  pure $ case result of
    Right response -> Right response
    Left (HttpExceptionRequest _ content) -> Left (translateExceptionContent content)
    Left (InvalidUrlException url reason) ->
      Left (HttpConnectionFailure ("invalid URL " ++ url ++ ": " ++ reason))

-- | Translate an 'HttpExceptionContent' into an 'HttpError'. The
-- 'ConnectionTimeout' / 'ResponseTimeout' arms map to 'HttpTimeout'; all
-- other failure modes map to 'HttpConnectionFailure'.
translateExceptionContent :: HttpExceptionContent -> HttpError
translateExceptionContent content = case content of
  ConnectionTimeout -> HttpTimeout "connection timeout"
  ResponseTimeout -> HttpTimeout "response timeout"
  StatusCodeException response body ->
    HttpStatus
      (statusCode (responseStatus response))
      (BL8.unpack (BL.fromStrict body))
  _ -> HttpConnectionFailure (renderExceptionContent content)

renderExceptionContent :: HttpExceptionContent -> String
renderExceptionContent = show

-- | GET the URL and return the response body as text. Non-2xx status is
-- reported through 'HttpError'.
httpGetText :: HttpConfig -> String -> IO (Either HttpError String)
httpGetText config url = do
  requestResult <- try (parseRequest url) :: IO (Either SomeException Request)
  case requestResult of
    Left ex -> pure (Left (HttpConnectionFailure (show ex)))
    Right request -> do
      result <- runRequest config request
      pure $ case result of
        Left err -> Left err
        Right response ->
          let status = statusCode (responseStatus response)
              body = BL8.unpack (responseBody response)
           in if status >= 200 && status < 300
                then Right body
                else Left (HttpStatus status body)

-- | GET the URL, decode the JSON response body into the requested type.
httpGetJson :: (FromJSON a) => HttpConfig -> String -> IO (Either HttpError a)
httpGetJson config url = do
  textResult <- httpGetText config url
  pure $ case textResult of
    Left err -> Left err
    Right body -> case eitherDecode (BL8.pack body) of
      Left err -> Left (HttpDecode err)
      Right value -> Right value

-- | POST a JSON payload and decode the JSON response body.
httpPostJsonResponseJson
  :: (ToJSON a, FromJSON b)
  => HttpConfig
  -> String
  -> a
  -> IO (Either HttpError b)
httpPostJsonResponseJson config url payload = do
  requestResult <- try (parseRequest url) :: IO (Either SomeException Request)
  case requestResult of
    Left ex -> pure (Left (HttpConnectionFailure (show ex)))
    Right baseRequest -> do
      let request =
            baseRequest
              { method = "POST"
              , requestBody = RequestBodyLBS (encode payload)
              , requestHeaders =
                  [ ("Content-Type", "application/json")
                  , ("Accept", "application/json")
                  ]
              }
      result <- runRequest config request
      pure $ case result of
        Left err -> Left err
        Right response ->
          let status = statusCode (responseStatus response)
              body = BL8.unpack (responseBody response)
           in if status >= 200 && status < 300
                then case eitherDecode (BL8.pack body) of
                  Left err -> Left (HttpDecode err)
                  Right value -> Right value
                else Left (HttpStatus status body)

-- | Send a request with an explicit method, extra request headers, and an
-- optional JSON-encoded body, returning the raw @(status, body)@ pair. The
-- shared engine the header-bearing helpers below build on — used by the
-- authenticated Vault surface (@X-Vault-Token@ + KV / Transit / @sys\/seal@).
sendRequestRaw
  :: HttpConfig
  -> Method
  -> [Header]
  -> String
  -> Maybe BL.ByteString
  -> IO (Either HttpError (Int, BL.ByteString))
sendRequestRaw config httpMethod extraHeaders url maybeBody = do
  requestResult <- try (parseRequest url) :: IO (Either SomeException Request)
  case requestResult of
    Left ex -> pure (Left (HttpConnectionFailure (show ex)))
    Right baseRequest -> do
      let request =
            baseRequest
              { method = httpMethod
              , requestHeaders =
                  ("Accept", "application/json")
                    : maybe [] (const [("Content-Type", "application/json")]) maybeBody
                    ++ extraHeaders
              , requestBody = maybe (requestBody baseRequest) RequestBodyLBS maybeBody
              }
      result <- runRequest config request
      pure $ case result of
        Left err -> Left err
        Right response ->
          Right (statusCode (responseStatus response), responseBody response)

-- | Send one request through the shared manager and retain the exact status and
-- response bytes.  This is the bounded-protocol substrate used by services
-- whose wire format is not JSON (for example the canonical-CBOR lifecycle
-- control-plane endpoints).  Status interpretation and response-size bounds
-- remain with the typed service client; transport errors stay normalized here.
httpRequestRaw
  :: HttpConfig
  -> Method
  -> [Header]
  -> String
  -> Maybe BL.ByteString
  -> IO (Either HttpError (Int, BL.ByteString))
httpRequestRaw = sendRequestRaw

-- | Send one request and stream its response body into memory only while the
-- caller-supplied bound holds.  Unlike checking the size after 'httpLbs', this
-- stops consuming as soon as a chunk crosses the ceiling, so an untrusted peer
-- cannot force an unbounded lazy response allocation before the typed protocol
-- client gets to validate it.
httpRequestRawBounded
  :: HttpConfig
  -> Int
  -> Method
  -> [Header]
  -> String
  -> Maybe BL.ByteString
  -> IO (Either HttpBoundedError (Int, BS.ByteString))
httpRequestRawBounded config maximumBytes httpMethod extraHeaders url maybeBody
  | maximumBytes < 0 = pure (Left (HttpBoundedResponseTooLarge 0 maximumBytes))
  | otherwise = do
      requestResult <- try (parseRequest url) :: IO (Either HttpException Request)
      case requestResult of
        Left ex ->
          pure
            (Left (HttpBoundedTransport (HttpConnectionFailure (show ex))))
        Right baseRequest -> do
          let requestWithoutTimeout =
                baseRequest
                  { method = httpMethod
                  , requestHeaders = extraHeaders
                  , requestBody = maybe (requestBody baseRequest) RequestBodyLBS maybeBody
                  }
              request =
                requestWithoutTimeout
                  { responseTimeout = responseTimeoutMicro (httpRequestTimeoutMicros config)
                  }
          result <-
            try
              ( withManager $ \manager ->
                  withResponse request manager $ \response -> do
                    boundedBody <- readBoundedBody maximumBytes (responseBody response)
                    pure (statusCode (responseStatus response), boundedBody)
              )
          pure $ case result of
            Left (HttpExceptionRequest _ content) ->
              Left (HttpBoundedTransport (translateExceptionContent content))
            Left (InvalidUrlException invalidUrl reason) ->
              Left
                ( HttpBoundedTransport
                    (HttpConnectionFailure ("invalid URL " ++ invalidUrl ++ ": " ++ reason))
                )
            Right (_status, Left observedBytes) ->
              Left (HttpBoundedResponseTooLarge observedBytes maximumBytes)
            Right (status, Right body) -> Right (status, body)

readBoundedBody
  :: Int
  -> BodyReader
  -> IO (Either Int BS.ByteString)
readBoundedBody maximumBytes = go 0 []
 where
  go observed chunks reader = do
    chunk <- brRead reader
    if BS.null chunk
      then pure (Right (BS.concat (reverse chunks)))
      else do
        let nextObserved = observed + BS.length chunk
        if nextObserved > maximumBytes
          then pure (Left nextObserved)
          else go nextObserved (chunk : chunks) reader

-- | Why a streaming download did not produce a complete, bounded body.
--
-- The size bound is separate from the transport taxonomy because crossing it
-- is a fact about the response rather than a failure to obtain one, and the
-- caller reports the two differently.
data HttpDownloadError
  = HttpDownloadTransport !HttpError
  | HttpDownloadTooLarge !Int !Int
  | HttpDownloadStatus !Int
  | HttpDownloadWriteFailed !String
  deriving (Eq, Show)

-- | What a completed download delivered.  The digest is computed over the
-- bytes as they are written, so it describes the file on disk rather than a
-- separate later read of it.
data HttpDownload = HttpDownload
  { httpDownloadBytes :: !Int
  , httpDownloadSha256 :: !String
  -- ^ Lowercase hex, without an algorithm prefix.
  }
  deriving (Eq, Show)

renderHttpDownloadError :: HttpDownloadError -> String
renderHttpDownloadError downloadErr = case downloadErr of
  HttpDownloadTransport httpErr -> renderHttpError httpErr
  HttpDownloadTooLarge observed maximumBytes ->
    "HTTP response exceeded the "
      ++ show maximumBytes
      ++ " byte ceiling at "
      ++ show observed
      ++ " bytes"
  HttpDownloadStatus status -> "HTTP " ++ show status ++ " response"
  HttpDownloadWriteFailed detail -> "download write failed: " ++ detail

-- | Stream a @GET@ body to a file under a byte ceiling, hashing it as it is
-- written.
--
-- Unlike 'httpRequestRawBounded' the body is never accumulated in memory: the
-- artifacts this exists for are hundreds of megabytes, and a retained-artifact
-- acquisition that had to hold its payload in the heap would be a resource
-- envelope rather than a transfer.  A response that crosses the ceiling, fails
-- mid-stream, or reports a non-2xx status leaves no completed file, so a
-- partial transfer cannot be mistaken for a delivered artifact.
httpDownloadToFile
  :: HttpConfig
  -> Int
  -> String
  -> FilePath
  -> IO (Either HttpDownloadError HttpDownload)
httpDownloadToFile config maximumBytes url destination
  | maximumBytes < 0 = pure (Left (HttpDownloadTooLarge 0 maximumBytes))
  | otherwise = do
      requestResult <- try (parseRequest url) :: IO (Either SomeException Request)
      case requestResult of
        Left ex ->
          pure (Left (HttpDownloadTransport (HttpConnectionFailure (show ex))))
        Right baseRequest -> do
          let request =
                baseRequest
                  { method = "GET"
                  , responseTimeout = responseTimeoutMicro (httpRequestTimeoutMicros config)
                  }
          streamed <-
            try
              ( withManager $ \manager ->
                  withResponse request manager $ \response ->
                    let status = statusCode (responseStatus response)
                     in if status < 200 || status >= 300
                          then pure (Left (HttpDownloadStatus status))
                          else withFile destination WriteMode $ \handle ->
                            streamBoundedBody
                              maximumBytes
                              (responseBody response)
                              handle
              )
          completed <- case streamed of
            Left (HttpExceptionRequest _ content) ->
              pure (Left (HttpDownloadTransport (translateExceptionContent content)))
            Left (InvalidUrlException invalidUrl reason) ->
              pure
                ( Left
                    ( HttpDownloadTransport
                        (HttpConnectionFailure ("invalid URL " ++ invalidUrl ++ ": " ++ reason))
                    )
                )
            Right outcome -> pure outcome
          case completed of
            Left err -> do
              _ <- try (removeFile destination) :: IO (Either SomeException ())
              pure (Left err)
            Right download -> pure (Right download)

streamBoundedBody
  :: Int
  -> BodyReader
  -> Handle
  -> IO (Either HttpDownloadError HttpDownload)
streamBoundedBody maximumBytes reader handle = go 0 SHA256.init
 where
  go observed context = do
    chunk <- brRead reader
    if BS.null chunk
      then
        pure
          ( Right
              HttpDownload
                { httpDownloadBytes = observed
                , httpDownloadSha256 = lowerHex (SHA256.finalize context)
                }
          )
      else do
        let nextObserved = observed + BS.length chunk
        if nextObserved > maximumBytes
          then pure (Left (HttpDownloadTooLarge nextObserved maximumBytes))
          else do
            written <- try (BS.hPut handle chunk) :: IO (Either SomeException ())
            case written of
              Left ex -> pure (Left (HttpDownloadWriteFailed (show ex)))
              Right () -> go nextObserved (SHA256.update context chunk)

lowerHex :: BS.ByteString -> String
lowerHex = concatMap renderByte . BS.unpack
 where
  renderByte byte =
    [hexDigit (byte `div` 16), hexDigit (byte `mod` 16)]
  hexDigit value
    | value < 10 = toEnum (fromEnum '0' + fromIntegral value)
    | otherwise = toEnum (fromEnum 'a' + fromIntegral value - 10)

-- | Decode a @(status, body)@ pair: any 2xx decodes the JSON body, anything
-- else becomes an 'HttpStatus'.
decodeJsonResponse :: (FromJSON a) => (Int, BL.ByteString) -> Either HttpError a
decodeJsonResponse (status, body)
  | status >= 200 && status < 300 =
      case eitherDecode body of
        Left err -> Left (HttpDecode err)
        Right value -> Right value
  | otherwise = Left (HttpStatus status (BL8.unpack body))

-- | GET with extra request headers (e.g. @X-Vault-Token@), decode JSON.
httpGetJsonWithHeaders
  :: (FromJSON a) => HttpConfig -> [Header] -> String -> IO (Either HttpError a)
httpGetJsonWithHeaders config extraHeaders url = do
  result <- sendRequestRaw config "GET" extraHeaders url Nothing
  pure (result >>= decodeJsonResponse)

-- | POST a JSON payload with extra request headers, decode the JSON response.
httpPostJsonWithHeaders
  :: (ToJSON a, FromJSON b)
  => HttpConfig
  -> [Header]
  -> String
  -> a
  -> IO (Either HttpError b)
httpPostJsonWithHeaders config extraHeaders url payload = do
  result <- sendRequestRaw config "POST" extraHeaders url (Just (encode payload))
  pure (result >>= decodeJsonResponse)

-- | POST a JSON payload with extra request headers and ignore the response
-- body. Any 2xx (including Vault's common 204 No Content) is success.
httpPostJsonNoResponse
  :: (ToJSON a)
  => HttpConfig
  -> [Header]
  -> String
  -> a
  -> IO (Either HttpError ())
httpPostJsonNoResponse config extraHeaders url payload = do
  result <- sendRequestRaw config "POST" extraHeaders url (Just (encode payload))
  pure $ case result of
    Left err -> Left err
    Right (status, body)
      | status >= 200 && status < 300 -> Right ()
      | otherwise -> Left (HttpStatus status (BL8.unpack body))

-- | Send a bodyless request (e.g. @PUT \/v1\/sys\/seal@) with extra headers;
-- any 2xx (including 204 No Content) is success and the response body is
-- ignored.
httpRequestNoBody
  :: HttpConfig -> Method -> [Header] -> String -> IO (Either HttpError ())
httpRequestNoBody config httpMethod extraHeaders url = do
  result <- sendRequestRaw config httpMethod extraHeaders url Nothing
  pure $ case result of
    Left err -> Left err
    Right (status, body)
      | status >= 200 && status < 300 -> Right ()
      | otherwise -> Left (HttpStatus status (BL8.unpack body))

writeInputs :: FilePath -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (FilePath, FilePath)
writeInputs directory configuration command = do
  let cfg = directory </> "settings.cbor"
      req = directory </> "request.cbor"
  BS.writeFile cfg configuration
  BS.writeFile req command
  mapM_ (`setFileMode` 0o600) [cfg, req]
  pure (cfg, req)

main :: IO ()
main = do
  arguments <- getArgs
  case arguments of
    ["authority-channel", scenario, path, forward] -> do
      directory <- makeAbsolute path
      helper <- makeAbsolute forward
      authorityChannel scenario directory helper
    ["local", path] -> local =<< makeAbsolute path
    ["physical", path] -> physical =<< makeAbsolute path
    ["publication", path] -> publication =<< makeAbsolute path
    ["published-physical", path] -> publishedPhysical =<< makeAbsolute path
    ["field", path] -> observeExpiredField False =<< makeAbsolute path
    ["field-retirement", path] -> observeExpiredField True =<< makeAbsolute path
    [mode, path]
      | mode
          `elem` [ "published-unsent"
                 , "published-unsent-expired"
                 , "published-unsent-exception"
                 , "published-unsent-cancel"
                 , "published-unsent-drift"
                 , "published-unsent-reload"
                 ] ->
          publishedUnsent mode =<< makeAbsolute path
    "internal-rpc-birth-controller" : flags -> controller flags
    _ -> fail "unsupported qualification invocation"

local :: FilePath -> IO ()
local directory = do
  (preparation, configBytes, requestBytes, started) <- fixture directory
  (cfg, req) <- writeInputs directory configBytes requestBytes
  escaped <- newIORef Nothing
  arguments <-
    right
      =<< withRpcBirthControllerLaunchFiles
        preparation
        cfg
        req
        ( \launch -> do
            value <- right =<< rpcBirthControllerLaunchArguments launch
            writeIORef escaped (Just launch)
            pure value
        )
  assert "renderer did not emit nine closed pairs" (length arguments == 18)
  parse <- right (parseRpcBirthControllerArguments arguments)
  lease <- newIORef Nothing
  result <-
    right
      =<< withRpcBirthControllerInputs
        parse
        ( \inputs -> do
            right =<< verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs inputs
            writeIORef lease (Just inputs)
            unmanaged <- withRpcBirthControllerProcesses inputs (const (fail "unmanaged callback executed"))
            assert
              "unmanaged process received physical admission"
              (case unmanaged of Left (ControllerLoadParentRefused _) -> True; _ -> False)
            pure
              ( rpcBirthControllerRequestKey
                  (rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest (rpcBirthControllerInputPreparation inputs))
              )
        )
  assert
    "loaded key changed"
    (result == rpcBirthControllerRequestKey (rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation))
  Just retained <- readIORef lease
  outside <- verifyRpcBirthControllerInputs retained
  assert
    "escaped file lease remained usable"
    (case outside of Left (ControllerLoadInputsRefused _) -> True; _ -> False)
  Just oldLaunch <- readIORef escaped
  closed <- rpcBirthControllerLaunchArguments oldLaunch
  assert
    "escaped launch remained usable"

replaceIn :: [String] -> String -> String -> [String]

  (preparation, _, _, started) <- fixtureWithKey key directory

  let original = rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation
      action launch = do

        let cfg = argumentValue "--config" args
            req = argumentValue "--request" args
        writeIORef saved (Just (launch, cfg, req))
        case mode of
          "published-unsent-expired" -> do
            now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
            let ending = started + 20000000000
            threadDelay (fromIntegral ((ending - min ending now) `div` 1000 + 1000))
          "published-unsent-exception" -> ioError (userError "authored never-sent caller failure")
          "published-unsent-cancel" -> throwIO ThreadKilled
          "published-unsent-drift" -> do
            renameFile cfg (cfg <> ".original")
            BS.writeFile cfg "foreign configuration"
            setFileMode cfg 0o400
          "published-unsent-reload" -> do
            reloaded <-
              right =<< withRpcBirthControllerLaunchFiles preparation cfg req submitRpcBirthControllerLaunch
            assert
              "unmarked raw-file reload bypassed the publisher"
              (case reloaded of Left (ControllerLoadInputsRefused _) -> True; _ -> False)

              "unmarked reload registered a submission"
              ( length names == 3
                  && all (`elem` [takeFileName cfg, takeFileName req, "publication-birth.cbor"]) names
              )
          "published-unsent" -> pure ()
          _ -> fail "unsupported never-sent fixture mode"
  attempted <-
    try (withPublishedRpcBirthControllerLaunchRetiringUnsent (started + 25000000000) preparation action)
      :: IO
           (Either SomeException (Either RpcBirthControllerLoadError (RpcBirthControllerPublicationResult ())))
  case attempted of

        assert
          "wrong caller exception"

      "published-unsent-cancel" ->
        assert
          "wrong caller cancellation"
          (case fromException cause of Just ThreadKilled -> True; _ -> False)

    Right result -> do
      assert
        "never-sent callback failure was swallowed"
        (mode `notElem` ["published-unsent-exception", "published-unsent-cancel"])
      report <- right result
      assert "never-sent caller outcome changed" (rpcBirthPublicationOutcome report == Right ())
      case rpcBirthPublicationDisposition report of

        ControllerUnsubmittedInputsUnresolved _ -> assert "unmodified input was unresolved" (mode == "published-unsent-drift")

  (launch, cfg, req) <- readIORef saved >>= maybe (fail "missing never-sent launch") pure
  escaped <- submitRpcBirthControllerLaunch launch
  assert
    "sealed launch submitted after cleanup"
    (case escaped of Left (ControllerLoadInputsRefused _) -> True; _ -> False)
  if mode == "published-unsent-drift"

  cold <- recoverNeverSentRpcBirthControllerInputs recoveryEnd original
  if mode == "published-unsent-drift"

    expired <-
      prepareRpcBirthControllerRequest original (rpcBirthControllerPreparedSettings preparation)
    assert
      "never-sent cleanup renewed work"
      (case expired of Left ControllerRequestExpired -> True; _ -> False)
  Lazy.writeFile (directory </> "observation.json") $
    encode $
      object
        [ "mode" .= mode
        , "configuration" .= cfg
        , "request" .= req
        , "started_ns" .= started
        , "sealed_launch_refused" .= True

controller :: [String] -> IO ()
controller flags = run `catch` failed
 where
  configuration = value "--config" flags
  value _ [] = error "missing controller fixture argument"
  value wanted (label : argument : rest) = if label == wanted then argument else value wanted rest
  value _ _ = error "malformed controller fixture arguments"
  directory = takeDirectory configuration
  failed :: IOException -> IO ()
  failed cause = writeFile (directory </> "controller-error") (show cause) >> ioError cause
  run = do
    arguments <- right (parseRpcBirthControllerArguments flags)
    right
      =<< withRpcBirthControllerInputs
        arguments
        ( \inputs -> do
            let preparation = rpcBirthControllerInputPreparation inputs
                root = S.resolvedManualPvHostRoot (rpcBirthControllerPreparedSettings preparation)
            channelCase <- doesFileExist (root </> "authority-channel-case")
            when channelCase $ do
              runtime <- lookupEnv "RUNTIME_DIRECTORY"
              present <- maybe (pure False) doesDirectoryExist runtime
              Lazy.writeFile (root </> "authority-channel-runtime.json") $
                encode (object ["runtime_directory" .= runtime, "runtime_present" .= present])
            readEnd <- (+ 1000000000) <$> getMonotonicTimeNSec
            _ <-
              right
                =<< observeRpcBirthControllerSubmission
                  readEnd
                  (value "--request" flags)
                  (rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation)
            right
              =<< withRpcBirthControllerProcesses
                inputs
                ( \processes -> do
                    if channelCase
                      then
                        ( do
                            writeFile (root </> "authority-channel-parent-admitted") "observed"
                            runAuthorityChannel
                              root
                              processes
                              (rpcBirthControllerRequestCoordination (rpcBirthControllerPreparedRequest preparation))
                        )
                          `catch` channelFailure root
                      else runOriginalProcesses processes
                )
            writeFile
              (root </> "controller-result")
              "PASS pinned loader, observed parent and concurrent command/transport\n"
        )
  runOriginalProcesses processes = do
    let spec path args =
          P.Subprocess
            path
            args
            (Just [("PATH", "/usr/bin:/bin"), ("LANG", "C.UTF-8")])
            (Just (P.operationSubprocessRuntimeDirectory processes))
    right
      =<< P.withOperationTransport
        processes
        (spec "/bin/sleep" ["2"])
        ( \transport -> do
            right =<< P.verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect transport
            output <- right =<< P.captureOperationCommand processes (spec "/bin/printf" ["%s", "admitted"])
            assert
              "command did not execute under its declared role"
              (P.operationProcessExitCode output == ExitSuccess && P.operationProcessStdout output == "admitted")
            pure ()
        )
  channelFailure root (cause :: IOException) = do
    writeFile (root </> "controller-error") (show cause)
    throwIO cause

runAuthorityChannel :: FilePath -> P.OperationSubprocesses -> RpcBirthCoordinationRequest -> IO ()
runAuthorityChannel directory processes request = do
  scenario <- readFile (directory </> "authority-channel-case")
  -- The native executeFile boundary searches its parent's PATH. Keep the
  -- fixture's explicit child environment and executable search identical.
  setEnv "PATH" (directory </> "mock-bin" <> ":/usr/bin:/bin")
  config <-
    right $
      prepareEmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
        "{\"apiVersion\":\"v1\",\"kind\":\"Config\",\"current-context\":\"home\",\"clusters\":[{\"name\":\"home\",\"cluster\":{\"server\":\"https://127.0.0.1:6443\",\"certificate-authority-data\":\"synthetic-ca\"}}],\"contexts\":[{\"name\":\"home\",\"context\":{\"cluster\":\"home\",\"user\":\"home\"}}],\"users\":[{\"name\":\"home\",\"user\":{\"client-certificate-data\":\"synthetic-cert\",\"client-key-data\":\"synthetic-key\"}}]}"
  count <- newIORef (0 :: Int)
  nonce <- newIORef (0 :: Int)
  nested <- newIORef False
  selected <- newIORef Nothing
  started <- newEmptyMVar
  release <- newEmptyMVar
  finished <- newIORef False
  let principal = CallerTestHarness
      baseSigner =
        localRequestSigningCapability $
          either (error . show) id $
            mkRequestSigner principal (either (error . show) id (mkSigningKeyGeneration 1)) (BS.replicate 32 41)
      record = modifyIORef' count (+ 1)
      call transport =
        Auth.callAuthenticatedClientTransport transport LifecycleMigrationApplyRoute "fixture-owned-request"
      signer =
        either (error . show) id $
          mkRequestSigningCapability
            principal
            (requestSigningCapabilityGeneration baseSigner)
            (requestSigningCapabilityPublicKeyBytes baseSigner)
            ( \bytes -> do
                record
                wasNested <- atomicModifyIORef' nested (True,)
                when (scenario == "nested" && not wasNested) $ do
                  saved <- readIORef selected
                  case saved of
                    Nothing -> fail "nested fixture transport missing"
                    Just transport -> do
                      reply <- call transport
                      assert "nested registry-shaped request failed" (not (isLeft reply))
                writeIORef nested False
                first (Text.pack . show) <$> signCanonicalBytesWithRequestCapability baseSigner bytes
            )
      provideSigner = do
        record
        when (scenario `elem` ["join-signer", "cancel-signer", "exception-signer", "cancel-owner"]) $
          (putMVar started () >> takeMVar release) `finally` writeIORef finished True
        pure (Right signer)
      providers =
        Auth.AuthenticatedClientProviders
          provideSigner
          (record >> pure (Right (rpcBirthCoordinationScope request)))
          (record >> pure (Right authorityEpochGenesis))
          (record >> pure (Right (rpcBirthCoordinationDeadline request)))
          ( do
              record
              value <- atomicModifyIORef' nonce (\old -> (old + 1, old + 1))
              pure (Right (either (error . show) id (mkRequestNonce (BS.replicate 16 (fromIntegral value)))))
          )
      environment =
        [ ("PATH", directory </> "mock-bin" <> ":/usr/bin:/bin")
        , ("LANG", "C.UTF-8")
        , ("FIXTURE_AUTHORITY_CHANNEL_ROOT", directory)
        ]
      bounds = either (error . show) id (Auth.mkAuthenticatedTransportBounds 65536 256 65000)
      owned =
        withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport processes config environment bounds providers
      output fields = Lazy.writeFile (directory </> "authority-channel.json") (encode (object fields))
  case scenario of
    "escape" -> escape owned call selected count output
    "nested" -> escape owned call selected count output
    "join-signer" -> Async.withAsync (readMVar started >> threadDelay 1000000 >> putMVar release ()) $ \releaser -> do
      worker <-
        right
          =<< owned
            ( \transport -> do
                task <- Async.async (call transport)
                readMVar started
                pure task
            )
      joined <- readIORef finished
      Async.wait releaser
      _ <- Async.waitCatch worker
      output ["provider_finished_at_return" .= joined]
    "cancel-signer" -> do
      right
        =<< owned
          ( \transport -> do
              worker <- Async.async (call transport)
              readMVar started
              Async.cancel worker
              outcome <- Async.waitCatch worker
              assert "cancelled provider returned a value" (isLeft outcome)
          )
      joined <- readIORef finished
      output ["cancelled_provider_joined" .= joined]
    "join-http" -> do
      worker <-
        right
          =<< owned
            ( \transport -> do
                task <- Async.async (call transport)
                waitForFile (directory </> "authority-channel-http-started")
                pure task
            )
      joined <- doesFileExist (directory </> "authority-channel-http-finished")
      _ <- Async.waitCatch worker
      output ["http_finished_at_return" .= joined]
    "cancel-http" -> do
      right
        =<< owned
          ( \transport -> do
              worker <- Async.async (call transport)
              waitForFile (directory </> "authority-channel-http-started")
              Async.cancel worker
              outcome <- Async.waitCatch worker
              assert "cancelled HTTP returned a value" (isLeft outcome)
          )
      output ["cancelled_http_joined" .= True]
    "exception-signer" -> Async.withAsync (readMVar started >> threadDelay 1000000 >> putMVar release ()) $ \releaser -> do
      saved <- newIORef Nothing
      outcome <-
        owned
          ( \transport -> do
              worker <- Async.async (call transport)
              writeIORef saved (Just worker)
              readMVar started
              ioError (userError "authored channel callback failure")
          )
      joined <- readIORef finished
      Async.wait releaser
      worker <- readIORef saved
      forM_ worker Async.waitCatch
      output ["callback_failure_refused" .= isLeft outcome, "provider_finished_at_failure" .= joined]
    "cancel-owner" -> Async.withAsync (readMVar started >> threadDelay 1000000 >> putMVar release ()) $ \releaser -> do
      saved <- newIORef Nothing
      parked <- newEmptyMVar
      owner <-
        Async.async $
          owned
            ( \transport -> do
                worker <- Async.async (call transport)
                writeIORef saved (Just worker)
                takeMVar parked
            )
      readMVar started
      Async.withAsync (Async.cancel owner) $ \firstCancel -> do
        threadDelay 10000
        Async.cancel owner
        Async.wait firstCancel
      joined <- readIORef finished
      Async.wait releaser
      worker <- readIORef saved
      forM_ worker Async.waitCatch
      output ["provider_finished_at_owner_cancel" .= joined]
    _ -> fail "unsupported native channel scenario"
 where
  waitForFile path = do
    present <- doesFileExist path
    unless present (threadDelay 1000 >> waitForFile path)
  escape owned call selected count output = do
    transport <-
      right
        =<< owned
          ( \value -> do
              writeIORef selected (Just value)
              inside <- call value
              assert "live native channel request failed" (not (isLeft inside))
              pure value
          )
    writeIORef count 0
    rawPort <- readFile (directory </> "authority-channel-port")
    let port = read rawPort :: Int
    observed <- newIORef (0 :: Int)
    bracket (Net.socket Net.AF_INET Net.Stream Net.defaultProtocol) Net.close $ \listener -> do
      Net.setSocketOption listener Net.ReuseAddr 1
      Net.bind listener (Net.SockAddrInet (fromIntegral port) (Net.tupleToHostAddress (127, 0, 0, 1)))
      Net.listen listener 8
      Async.withAsync
        ( forever $ bracket (fst <$> Net.accept listener) Net.close $ \connection -> do
            _ <- recv connection 65536
            modifyIORef' observed (+ 1)
            sendAll connection "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\nok"
        )
        $ \_ -> do
          attempted <- timeout 2000000 (call transport)
          calls <- readIORef count
          packets <- readIORef observed
          output
            [ "escaped_success" .= maybe False (not . isLeft) attempted
            , "provider_calls_after_release" .= calls
            , "http_requests_after_release" .= packets
            ]

-- | Minimal native loopback stand-in for the operation-owned kubectl child.
-- No Kubernetes/AWS connection or credential is consumed by this fixture.
module Main (main) where

import Control.Concurrent (threadDelay)
import Control.Exception (bracket)
import Control.Monad (forever, when)
import Data.ByteString qualified as BS
import Data.ByteString.Char8 qualified as B8
import Network.Socket
import Network.Socket.ByteString (recv, sendAll)
import System.Environment (getArgs, getEnv)
import Text.Read (readMaybe)

main :: IO ()
main = withSocketsDo $ do
  arguments <- getArgs
  port <- case [ number
               | argument <- arguments
               , ':' `elem` argument
               , Just number <- [readMaybe (takeWhile (/= ':') argument) :: Maybe Int]
               ] of
    [number] -> pure number
    _ -> fail "fixture requires one forwarded port"
  directory <- getEnv "FIXTURE_AUTHORITY_CHANNEL_ROOT"
  scenario <- readFile (directory <> "/authority-channel-case")
  bracket (socket AF_INET Stream defaultProtocol) close $ \listener -> do
    setSocketOption listener ReuseAddr 1
    bind listener (SockAddrInet (fromIntegral port) (tupleToHostAddress (127, 0, 0, 1)))
    listen listener 8
    writeFile (directory <> "/authority-channel-port") (show port)
    forever $ bracket (fst <$> accept listener) close $ \connection -> do
      bytes <- headers connection BS.empty
      let post = "POST " `BS.isPrefixOf` bytes
      when post $ do
        writeFile (directory <> "/authority-channel-http-started") "observed"
        when (scenario `elem` ["join-http", "cancel-http"]) (threadDelay 1000000)
        writeFile (directory <> "/authority-channel-http-finished") "observed"
      sendAll connection "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\nok"

headers :: Socket -> BS.ByteString -> IO BS.ByteString
headers connection previous
  | "\r\n\r\n" `BS.isInfixOf` previous = pure previous
  | BS.length previous >= 65536 = fail "fixture header bound"
  | otherwise = do
      bytes <- recv connection 4096
      if BS.null bytes
        then fail ("fixture EOF: " <> B8.unpack previous)
        else headers connection (previous <> bytes)

  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline

  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityProcessStartFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed !String
  | LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid !ControlPlaneClientError
  deriving stock (Eq, Show)

renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError :: LocalLifecycleAuthorityError -> String
renderLocalLifecycleAuthorityError err = case err of
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause -> "owned Lifecycle Authority transport: " ++ show cause
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline -> "owned Lifecycle Authority transport reached its original work deadline"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed -> "prepare owned Lifecycle Authority kubeconfig workspace"
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityKubeconfigFailed detail ->
    "resolve home Lifecycle Authority kubeconfig: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail ->
    "reserve Lifecycle Authority loopback port: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityProcessStartFailed detail ->
    "start Lifecycle Authority Service port-forward: " ++ detail
  LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed detail ->

  LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid detail ->

  :: (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)

withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClientUsing
  :: ( Int
       -> Either
            ControlPlaneClientError
            (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime)
     )
  -> (ControlPlaneClient 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClientUsing buildClient action = do
  kubeconfigResult <- resolveLocalKubeconfig
  case kubeconfigResult of
    Left detail -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityKubeconfigFailed detail))
    Right kubeconfig -> do
      portResult <- reserveLoopbackPort
      case portResult of
        Left detail ->
          pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail))
        Right localPort -> do
          environment <- homeKubectlEnvironment kubeconfig
          bracket
            (startForward environment localPort)
            cleanupForward
            (runWithForward localPort)
 where
  runWithForward _ (Left err) = pure (Left err)
  runWithForward localPort (Right _) = do
    ready <- waitUntilStartupProbe LifecycleAuthorityRuntime localPort readinessAttempts
    case ready of
      Left detail ->
        pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed detail))
      Right () ->
        case buildClient localPort of
          Left err -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid err))
          Right client -> Right <$> action client

-- | Open the same loopback-only connection but expose only the complete
-- authenticated transport.  Signer, scope, epoch, deadline, and durable nonce
-- ownership are explicit caller inputs; this boundary never invents them from
-- host state.
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport
  :: AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withLocalLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport bounds providers action =
  withLocalLifecycleAuthorityClient
    (action . mkAuthenticatedClientTransport bounds providers)

-- The operation owns both this persistent child and all concurrent command work.
-- Only the canonical retained-home Authority mapping is representable here.
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport
  :: OperationSubprocesses
  -> EmbeddedHomeKubeconfig
  -> [(String, String)]
  -> AuthenticatedTransportBounds
  -> AuthenticatedClientProviders IO
  -> (AuthenticatedClientTransport 'LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError value)
withOperationLifecycleAuthorityAuthenticatedTransport processes config environment bounds providers action = do
  admitted <- verifyOperationSubprocessesBeforeEffect processes
  case admitted of
    Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
    Right () -> do
      attempted <- tryOperationClientWorkspace $ do
        directory <-
          createTempDirectory (operationSubprocessRuntimeDirectory processes) "authority-forward-"
        use directory
      pure (either (const (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed)) id attempted)
 where
  use directory = do
    written <- writeEmbeddedHomeKubeconfig directory config
    case written of
      Left _ -> pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityWorkspaceFailed)
      Right kubeconfig -> do
        port <- reserveLoopbackPort
        case port of
          Left detail -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityPortReservationFailed detail))
          Right localPort -> do
            let childEnvironment =
                  [ ("HOME", directory)
                  , ("XDG_CACHE_HOME", directory </> "cache")
                  , ("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", directory </> "config")
                  , ("XDG_DATA_HOME", directory </> "data")
                  ]
                    ++ filter (not . privateEnvironmentKey . fst) environment
                spec =
                  Subprocess
                    { subprocessPath = "kubectl"
                    , subprocessArguments =
                        [ "--kubeconfig"
                        , kubeconfig
                        , "--cache-dir"
                        , directory </> "cache"
                        , "--namespace"
                        , lifecycleAuthorityNamespace
                        , "port-forward"
                        , lifecycleAuthorityForwardTarget
                        , show localPort ++ ":" ++ show lifecycleAuthorityRemotePort
                        , "--address"
                        , "127.0.0.1"
                        ]
                    , subprocessEnvironment = Just childEnvironment
                    , subprocessWorkingDirectory = Just directory
                    }
            forwarded <- withOperationTransport processes spec $ \lease -> do
              ready <- waitOperationAuthorityReady lease localPort
              case ready of
                Left cause -> pure (Left cause)
                Right () -> case lifecycleAuthorityClientWithResponseMaximum
                  ReplayBudget.authorityMetadataResponseMaximumBytes
                  localPort of
                  Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityClientInvalid cause))
                  Right client -> Right <$> action (mkAuthenticatedClientTransport bounds providers client)
            pure (either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed) id forwarded)
  privateEnvironmentKey key =
    forbiddenKubectlEnvironmentKey key
      || key `elem` ["HOME", "XDG_CACHE_HOME", "XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "XDG_DATA_HOME"]

tryOperationClientWorkspace :: IO value -> IO (Either IOException value)
tryOperationClientWorkspace = try

waitOperationAuthorityReady
  :: OperationTransport -> Int -> IO (Either LocalLifecycleAuthorityError ())
waitOperationAuthorityReady lease localPort = loop
 where
  ending = operationTransportWorkEnd lease
  endpoint = loopbackEndpoint localPort ++ localClientStartupProbePath LifecycleAuthorityRuntime
  loop = do
    observed <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
    case observed of
      Left cause -> pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed cause))
      Right () -> do
        now <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
        if now >= ending || ending - now < 1000
          then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
          else do
            let allowance = fromInteger (min 1000000 (toInteger ((ending - now) `div` 1000)))
            response <-
              timeout allowance $
                httpRequestRawBounded (HttpConfig allowance) 4096 "GET" [] endpoint Nothing
            after <- getMonotonicTimeNSec
            if after >= ending
              then pure (Left LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationDeadline)
              else case response of
                Just (Right (status, _)) | status >= 200 && status < 300 -> do
                  closing <- verifyOperationTransportBeforeEffect lease
                  pure (either (Left . LocalLifecycleAuthorityOperationFailed) (const (Right ())) closing)
                Just (Left (HttpBoundedResponseTooLarge _ _)) ->
                  pure (Left (LocalLifecycleAuthorityReadinessFailed "startup response exceeds its 4096-byte bound"))
                _ -> do
                  threadDelay (fromInteger (min 250000 ((toInteger ending - toInteger after) `div` 1000)))
                  loop

renderLocalProviderWorkerError :: LocalProviderWorkerError -> String
renderLocalProviderWorkerError err = case err of
  LocalProviderWorkerKubeconfigFailed detail ->
    "resolve home Provider Worker kubeconfig: " ++ detail
  LocalProviderWorkerPortReservationFailed detail ->
    "reserve Provider Worker loopback port: " ++ detail
  LocalProviderWorkerProcessStartFailed detail ->
    "start Provider Worker Service port-forward: " ++ detail
  LocalProviderWorkerReadinessFailed detail ->

withLocalProviderWorkerClient
  :: (ControlPlaneClient 'ProviderWorkerRuntime -> IO value)
  -> IO (Either LocalProviderWorkerError value)
withLocalProviderWorkerClient action = do
  kubeconfigResult <- resolveLocalKubeconfig
  case kubeconfigResult of
    Left detail -> pure (Left (LocalProviderWorkerKubeconfigFailed detail))
    Right kubeconfig -> do
      portResult <- reserveLoopbackPort
      case portResult of
        Left detail -> pure (Left (LocalProviderWorkerPortReservationFailed detail))
        Right localPort -> do
          environment <- homeKubectlEnvironment kubeconfig
          bracket

-- | Retry the complete disposable Authority Backup port-forward lifecycle.
-- Only listener liveness is pending: setup/client failures are terminal, and
-- the user action is inside a successful attempt so its result is never
-- repeated. 'bracket' retires the current child before the inter-attempt delay.
retryAuthorityBackupForwardWith
  :: Int
  -> IO ()
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError process)
  -> (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError process -> IO ())
  -> (process -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError value))
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError value)
retryAuthorityBackupForwardWith attemptBudget delay acquire release use =
  go (max 1 attemptBudget)
 where
  go remaining = do
    result <-
      bracket acquire release runStarted
    case result of
      Left err@(LocalAuthorityBackupLivenessFailed _)
        | remaining > 1 -> delay >> go (remaining - 1)
        | otherwise -> pure (Left err)
      _ -> pure result
  runStarted started = case started of
    Left err -> pure (Left err)
    Right process -> use process

waitForAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
  :: Int
  -> BackgroundProcess
  -> IO (Either LocalAuthorityBackupError ())
waitForAuthorityBackupForwardStartup localPort process =
  case backgroundStdoutHandle process of
    Nothing ->
      pure
        ( classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
            localPort
            AuthorityBackupForwardStartupReadFailed
        )
    Just stdoutHandle -> do
      observed <-
        timeout
          authorityBackupForwardStartupTimeoutMicros
          (try (hGetLine stdoutHandle) :: IO (Either IOException String))
      pure
        ( classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
            localPort
            ( case observed of
                Nothing -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupTimedOut
                Just (Left _) -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupReadFailed
                Just (Right line) -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupLine line
            )
        )

classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup
  :: Int
  -> AuthorityBackupForwardStartupObservation
  -> Either LocalAuthorityBackupError ()
classifyAuthorityBackupForwardStartup localPort observation =
  case observation of
    AuthorityBackupForwardStartupTimedOut -> refused "startup acknowledgement timed out"
    AuthorityBackupForwardStartupReadFailed -> refused "startup acknowledgement unavailable"
    AuthorityBackupForwardStartupLine line
      | line `elem` expectedLines -> Right ()
      | otherwise -> refused "startup acknowledgement did not match the compiled loopback mapping"
 where
  refused = Left . LocalAuthorityBackupLivenessFailed
  expectedLines =
    [ "Forwarding from 127.0.0.1:" ++ show localPort ++ mappingSuffix
    , "Forwarding from [::1]:" ++ show localPort ++ mappingSuffix
    ]
  mappingSuffix = " -> " ++ show authorityBackupRemotePort

waitUntilStartupProbe :: RuntimeRole -> Int -> Int -> IO (Either String ())
waitUntilStartupProbe role localPort remaining = do
  result <-
    httpRequestNoBody
      readinessHttpConfig
      "GET"
      []
      (loopbackEndpoint localPort ++ localClientStartupProbePath role)
  case result of
    Right () -> pure (Right ())
    Left err
      | remaining <= 1 -> pure (Left (renderHttpError err))
      | otherwise -> do
          threadDelay 250000
          waitUntilStartupProbe role localPort (remaining - 1)

  LifecycleAuthorityRuntime -> "/readyz"
  ProviderWorkerRuntime -> "/readyz"

reserveLoopbackPort :: IO (Either String Int)
reserveLoopbackPort = do
  attempted <-
    try
      ( withSocketsDo $
          bracket
            (socket AF_INET Stream defaultProtocol)
            close
            ( \reserved -> do
                setSocketOption reserved ReuseAddr 1
                bind reserved (SockAddrInet 0 (tupleToHostAddress (127, 0, 0, 1)))
                address <- getSocketName reserved
                case address of
                  SockAddrInet port _ -> pure (fromIntegral port)
                  _ -> ioError (userError "reserved socket was not IPv4")
            )
      )
      :: IO (Either IOException Int)
  pure (either (Left . displayException) Right attempted)
